title: Proof of Lichiardopol's conjecture on disjoint directed cycles of distinct lengths
summary: There is a fascinating array of interrelated questions studying which structures can be guaranteed in digraphs of large minimum out-degree. These often have intriguingly simple statements, yet seem surprisingly difficult to approach. A well-known example is Lichiardopol's conjecture (2014), stating that there exists a function $g:\mathbb{N}\rightarrow \mathbb{N}$ such that every digraph with minimum out-degree at least $g(k)$ contains $k$ vertex-disjoint directed cycles of distinct lengths. In this paper, building on earlier work of the second author, we confirm this conjecture in full…
